integration_decision.name: FREEZE_STATIC_CONTRACT_REQUIRE_EXECUTABLE_GENERATION_EVIDENCE
integration_decision.finding: Pinned spawn preflight executes A to completion before B starts; it cannot prove or disprove stale/mixed generation. Source runner.py publishes latest.json, audit_latest.json and anata_latest.json with three separate atomic_write_json calls outside ArchiveWriterLock. Same as_of_ms is not generation identity. The contract is sufficiently specified; further static rewriting does not clear the blocker.
integration_decision.runnable_no_network_contract: At exact pinned SHA, use spawn-safe top-level child targets and a shared tmp_path. A run_once(network=False,as_of_ms=T) reads empty archive and pauses via an Event before ONLY its anata_latest.json atomic_write_json; require A still alive, 0/0 counts, and parse/hash A latest/audit with anata absent. Append one valid PIT-visible rowB; B run_once(network=False,as_of_ms=T) completes 1/1 and persists rowB scoring effective.source_record_id; require B latest/audit SHA256 differ from A and snapshot B all three parsed files/hashes. Release A in whole-test finally, join/terminate bounded children, compare final three files to B: stale handoff if rowB disappears; other mismatch mixed generation; exact triple retained no overwrite. If A/B delta or child completion absent, INVALID_TEST. Preserve failure logs; do not patch or weaken assertion.
integration_decision.note: These commands are specified, not executed independently; paused-A regression file was never committed because Gemini JSON failed.

blocker.recovery: Provide authorized disposable exact-SHA checkout or safe read-only hosted runner. Execute controlled two-writer regression and collect-only/targeted/full Capital Flow pytest, retain logs, seek independent Planner C audit. No repeated DNS clone or malformed Gemini enqueue.
